name: self-chrome
description: Lets a session make sure Chrome runs for Claude in Chrome: it looks for your Chrome, starts it when it isn't running (the profile you name, or the one Chrome used last; the last session restored; and --silent-debugger-extension-api when you opt in), and reconnects Claude in Chrome once the turn ends. It never quits or restarts Chrome.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: when a tool of this plugin is called and the last check is 30 minutes old, fetch this plugin's published plugin.json from GitHub (a plain GET of a public file) and say when a newer version is out. off: never check.

silentDebugger.title: Silent debugger flag
silentDebugger.description: Whether a Chrome this plugin starts gets --silent-debugger-extension-api, which hides Chrome's "is debugging this browser" banner for every extension and every profile in that Chrome. auto: only when the environment variable CLAUDE_CHROME_SILENT_DEBUGGER is 1, true or on. on: always. off: never. Chrome takes the flag only when it starts.

profile.title: Chrome profile
profile.description: The profile folder a Chrome this plugin starts opens, by its folder's name (Default, Profile 2); it must be one of Chrome's profile folders. Empty: none, and Chrome opens the profile it used last.

chromePath.title: Chrome executable
chromePath.description: Chrome's executable, as an absolute path with no [, ] or backtick: chrome.exe on Windows, the Google Chrome binary inside its .app on macOS. Empty: the standard install paths.
